verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਝ ਬਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਪੰੁਸਕ ਨ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਸਲਲ ਬਿਲੋਏ ਕਤ ਮਾਖਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baa(n)jh badhoo purakh nipa(n)usak na sa(n)tat hui salal biloe kat maakhan pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a barren woman and an impotent man cannot produce children, and churning of water cannot yield butter.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਨ ਗਹਿ ਦੁਗਧ ਪੀਆਏ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੂਰੀ ਖਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਸੈ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: fan geh dhugadh peeaae na miTat bikh mooree khaae mukh sai na pragaTe subaas hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a poison of a cobra cannot be destroyed by feeding him milk and one cannot get good smell from mouth after eating radish.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸਰ ਪਰ ਬੈਠੇ ਬਾਇਸੁ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਲੇਪੁ ਖਰ ਭਸਮ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: maanasar par baiThe bais udhaas baas aragajaa lep khar bhasam nivaas hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a filth-eating crow on reaching lake Mansarover, becomes sad since he cannot get filth which he is so used to eating; and a donkey will roll in dust even if it is given a bath with sweet smelling scents.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕਠਨ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੫॥
verses.translit_en: aan dhev sevak na jaane gurdhev sev kaThan kuTev na miTat dhev dhaas hai ||445||

en.bdb: Similarly, the servant of other gods cannot realise the ecstasy of serving the True Guru, because the chronic and bad habits of the followers of god cannot perish.  (445)
